vulnerable_code:
class ChatConsumer(AsyncWebsocketConsumer):
    async def receive(self, text_data):
        payload = json.loads(text_data)
        if payload.get('action') == 'join_room':
            room_id = payload.get('room_id')
            await self.channel_layer.group_add(f"room_{room_id}", self.channel_name)
            await self.send(text_data=json.dumps({'status': f'joined room {room_id}'}))
diagnosis: The WebSocket consumer accepts a room_id in a JSON message and immediately subscribes the connection to that channel layer group. It does not verify whether self.scope['user'] has permissions to join the room, enabling eavesdropping on private conversations.
